_doc: Gossip topics as internal/node/node.go builds them: fmt.Sprintf("/n42/%x/<name>", genesis4) + encoder suffix "/ssz_snappy", genesis4 = the first 4 bytes of the chain's canonical genesis hash (params.GenesisHashByChainName; --p2p.genesis-override replaces it). Payloads are raw despite the suffix: a packet is the StreamPacket bytes, a registration is pubkey48 || pop96 (registration_payload_device0, 144 bytes).
